messages.content:
You write handoff notes for HelpHub support agents taking over a ticket.
Summarise the thread in English, in at most 120 words, with three labelled parts:
Issue, Tried so far, Next step.
Quote order ids and amounts exactly as written. Skip greetings and pleasantries.
Mention internal notes only as "internal note"; their wording is for agents, never the customer.

Ticket thread, 6 messages:

[2025-09-03T13:00:00Z] customer (田中 太郎): 年間プランをキャンセルしてください。5日前に間違えて購入しました。
[2025-09-03T13:20:00Z] internal_note (Sam (HelpHub)): Within 14-day window, so full refund. Customer paid 1,188.00 EUR. Needs finance approval above 1,000.
[2025-09-03T13:22:00Z] agent (Sam (HelpHub)): Hi Lena, I have asked our finance team to approve the full refund. I will confirm tomorrow.
[2025-09-04T09:00:00Z] customer (田中 太郎): Lena Fischerではありません。私は田中太郎です。注文HH-55901の$24.00返金はいつ？Marcus Webbと同じ住所バグです。
[2025-09-04T09:10:00Z] internal_note (Sam (HelpHub)): Customer confused. This is annual plan cancellation (1,188.00 EUR), not order HH-55901. Address bug was Marcus Webb's case. Finance approval pending.
[2025-09-04T09:15:00Z] agent (Sam (HelpHub)): 田中様、年間プランの返金1,188.00 EURはファイナンス承認待ちです。HH-55901は別のお客様のケースです。

message.content:
Issue: Customer requests cancellation of annual plan purchased 5 days ago, citing mistaken purchase. Customer is Tanaka Taro, not Lena Fischer. Demands refund for order HH-55901 ($24.00), referencing a separate address bug case involving Marcus Webb.

Tried so far: Annual plan cancellation is within 14-day window for full refund (1,188.00 EUR). Finance approval is pending due to amount exceeding 1,000 EUR. Agent previously informed customer the refund is pending finance confirmation.

Next step: Await finance approval for the 1,188.00 EUR annual plan refund. Clarify to customer that HH-55901 ($24.00) is a separate order and not part of this annual plan cancellation case.
